newsitem.title: SPAIN: Valenciana negotiates 108 bln pta loan.
newsitem.headline: Valenciana negotiates 108 bln pta loan.

text.p: Spanish cement maker Valenciana de Cementos, a subsidiary of Mexico's Cemex, is negotiating a multi-currency syndicated loan of 108.4 billion pesetas ($852.4 million) to buy two firms in the same group, a press statement said on Tuesday.
Valenciana is set to acquire Venezuelan company Venezolana de Cementos (Vencemos ) and the U.S. Sunbelt Corporation. Both are part of the Cemex group.
The loan has a maturity of seven years and is also aimed at restructuring Valenciana de Cementos' debt burden.
Vencemos has a market share of 48 percent in Venezuela and a production capacity of 4.5 million tonnes. Sunbelt Corporation has a production capacity of one million tonnes.
